text:
claire (Design): Quick thread about the Roles CSV export and the new Invite flow when SSO is enabled. Two UX pain points from user interviews: 1) Exported CSV shows internal role IDs instead of friendly names; 2) bulk-invite modal still lets users pick a role but it gets overridden by SSO which is confusing.
diego (PM): Yep, we got a support spike. Customers opened tickets saying "why did our CSV show 'role_3f9' instead of 'Admin'" and that bulk invites appeared to silently assign different roles. Need clarity and safer defaults.
yana (FE): Current export uses server payload: roles.map(r => r.id). Easy fix to include name. But legacy consumers rely on ID. We should include both columns: Role ID and Role name. That keeps backwards compatibility.
sam (A11y): small accessibility note for the export UI: the filename suggested in the download button should be descriptive and announced by screen readers. Use aria-label on the button like "Download roles CSV, includes role names and ids".
claire (Design): for bulk-invite modal when SSO is on, proposal: disable role dropdown and show a read-only hint line: "Role assignments are controlled by SSO. Invites will use IdP mappings." Add a subtle banner inside the modal that explains how to preview mappings (optional feature) and a link to provisioning docs. Also show an explicit confirmation text before sending: "Send invites (roles assigned by SSO)".
diego (PM): love the confirmation text. Add an acceptance criteria: require an extra explicit checkbox when inviting >50 users: "I understand roles will be assigned by my IdP". That should reduce accidental mis-invites.
yana (FE): checkbox is straightforward. For the hint line, should it be a non-focusable paragraph or an info button to open more details? Keyboard users need an accessible path to learn more.
sam (A11y): prefer an info button that opens a dialog with role mapping preview or docs link. The button must be tabbable, have aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-controls pointing to the content. Dialog should be non-modal (role=region) unless we want to trap focus. Also ensure contrast on the banner.
claire (Design): (typo) meant claire: also: we should avoid showing exact mapping examples unless we sanitize — ops asked in interviews about leaking user-domain mappings. Better to show abstracted examples like "*@example.com -> Member" not real emails.
diego (PM): ops-bot flagged that mapping previews are logged by proxies; ask backend to add a header to prevent logging and to scrub responses. Also limit preview access to org admins.
yana (FE): implementation plan: 1) CSV: add role_name column, keep role_id for compatibility; 2) Bulk-invite modal: replace active select with read-only hint + info button; 3) Add confirmation checkbox for large batches; 4) Wire dialog accessible; 5) Add telemetry event when users open mapping preview (opt-in flag). I'll open PRs for CSV + invite hotfix.
sam (A11y): once PR is up, happy to run keyboard-only testing and a11y scan. Also request we add unit tests ensuring download button has aria-label and that dialog has aria-labelledby.
ops-bot: preview build deployed to staging at 2026-03-27T07:30Z for branch fix/roles-csv-invite-clarity :rocket:
diego (PM): timeline: hotfix for CSV & invite UX this week; mapping preview + opt-in flag next sprint with privacy review. Claire, can you add the final microcopy for the banner and confirmation checkbox to the ticket?
claire (Design): will do. Draft copy: Banner: "Roles managed by your SSO provider. Invited users will receive the role mapped by your IdP." Confirmation checkbox label: "I understand invited users will receive roles assigned by our IdP." Keeping it plain language.
diego (PM): great. Thanks team — let's catch regressions in the keyboard pass tomorrow afternoon. :coffee:
